presentation.tagline: Web the thugs. Zip the rooftops. Save downtown.

actions.text: Downtown. Press X to shoot a web: it webs a thug, or zips you to a wall.

components.lockedText: Chained from the inside. The Enforcer only opens for someone the city talks about (3 reputation).

actions.text: He drops Rosa's purse. Take it back to her.

action.text: A hand-painted board: "OUR FRIENDLY NEIGHBOURHOOD HERO LIVES HERE (allegedly)".
THE DAILY BUZZ. Today: "MASKED MENACE OR MISUNDERSTOOD?" Photos wanted, see the editor.
PAPA RAY'S: 30 minutes or it's free. Deliveries by rooftop welcome.
CITY BANK. Please do not rob us. Thank you.
You watch the water for a moment. Somewhere, a siren.
A thug, webbed to the wall since yesterday. He asks what time it is.

actions.text: The Enforcer goes down. The warehouse is quiet.

action.text: Someone got here before you. He looks embarrassed.

nod_mae_hello.speaker: Aunt Mae
nod_mae_hello.text: There you are! Off to "the library" again in that outfit? Mm-hm. Be careful out there, the radio says thugs are everywhere.

nod_mae_tip.speaker: Aunt Mae
nod_mae_tip.text: Rosa at the flower market lost her purse, Ray needs a delivery boy, and that awful newspaper man wants photos. Everyone needs a hero. Eat something first.

nod_mae_again.speaker: Aunt Mae
nod_mae_again.text: Still out? Remember: with great power comes a great big appetite. There is pizza money on the counter.

nod_gwen_hello.speaker: Gwen
nod_gwen_hello.text: Are you the spider guy? My friend Miles went to look at the warehouse roof and never came back. The Enforcer's people are up there.

nod_gwen_more.speaker: Gwen
nod_gwen_more.text: You can climb, right? Walk into a wall and keep going. Or press X at a building: the web pulls you up. I saw you do it. Everyone saw.

nod_rosa_thanks.speaker: Rosa
nod_rosa_thanks.text: My hero! The flowers are on the house. Well, one flower. Business is business.

nod_rosa_found.speaker: Rosa
nod_rosa_found.text: My purse! Everything is still in it, even the coupons. Thank you, thank you!

nod_rosa_looking.speaker: Rosa
nod_rosa_looking.text: He ran into the alley behind my stall, the one with the dumpster. Green hoodie, baseball bat, no manners.

nod_rosa_hello.speaker: Rosa
nod_rosa_hello.text: A masked man! Good, I need one. A thug grabbed my purse and ran into the alley behind the stalls. Get it back and I will remember you.

nod_rosa_job2.speaker: Rosa
nod_rosa_job2.text: Web him, punch him, whatever you people do. Just bring the purse.

nod_rosa_police.speaker: Rosa
nod_rosa_police.text: Officer Lee is busy with the bank. Which is being robbed. Right now. This city, I tell you.

nod_ray_hurry.speaker: Papa Ray
nod_ray_hurry.text: Why is the pizza still here?! Mr. Delmar, Grand Hotel roof, north-east. Sixty seconds! Use the roofs!

nod_ray_hello.speaker: Papa Ray
nod_ray_hello.text: Papa Ray's, best slice downtown. You look like someone who can get to a roof fast. I have a customer on the Grand Hotel roof and no delivery boy.

nod_ray_again.speaker: Papa Ray
nod_ray_again.text: Ah, the fast one. Another delivery?

nod_ray_job2.speaker: Papa Ray
nod_ray_job2.text: Grand Hotel, north-east, on the ROOF. Mr. Delmar. Sixty seconds or he does not pay and neither do I. Go go go!

nod_ray_bye.speaker: Papa Ray
nod_ray_bye.text: Fine. The pizza waits for no one.

nod_delmar_got.speaker: Mr. Delmar
nod_delmar_got.text: By rooftop! Still hot! Kid, you are wasted on this town. Here is a tip.

nod_delmar_idle.speaker: Mr. Delmar
nod_delmar_idle.text: Best view in the city, worst pizza delivery times. Papa Ray keeps promising.

nod_lee_hero.speaker: Officer Lee
nod_lee_hero.text: Bank saved, kid saved. I did not see you climb that wall and I will keep not seeing it. Go get the Enforcer.

nod_lee_rescue_wait.speaker: Officer Lee
nod_lee_rescue_wait.text: Miles is still on the warehouse roof, south-east. Two of them up there with bats. Roofs are your thing, not mine.

nod_lee_rescue2.speaker: Officer Lee
nod_lee_rescue2.text: Bank's clear, thanks to you. Next: a kid named Miles is being held on the warehouse roof, south-east. I can't get up there. You can.

nod_lee_wait.speaker: Officer Lee
nod_lee_wait.text: Three of them at the bank, south side of Main across Park Avenue. Bats. Web them first, then hit them; they cannot swing back when they are wrapped.

nod_lee_hello.speaker: Officer Lee
nod_lee_hello.text: Halt! ...oh. The spider fella. Look, the City Bank is being robbed right now, three thugs, and my backup is on lunch. Care to help?

nod_lee_job2.speaker: Officer Lee
nod_lee_job2.text: South of Main, across Park Avenue, the white building with the columns. Tip: a webbed thug takes double damage.

nod_jj_after.speaker: J. J. Jameson
nod_jj_after.text: Front page! "MENACE CAUGHT ON CAMERA". Sold out in an hour. Bring me more and I will call you a hero. Maybe. In small print.

nod_jj_pay.speaker: J. J. Jameson
nod_jj_pay.text: Three photos of that wall-crawling menace! Grainy, blurry, perfect. Here is your money, do not spend it on web fluid.

nod_jj_looking.speaker: J. J. Jameson
nod_jj_looking.text: Three photos! From the ROOFS, where the menace hangs out. Buzz roof, Apartments roof, Grand Hotel roof. Chop chop!

nod_jj_hello.speaker: J. J. Jameson
nod_jj_hello.text: You! Kid! You look like you own a camera. The Daily Buzz pays for pictures of the masked menace. Three good ones, taken from the rooftops.

nod_jj_job2.speaker: J. J. Jameson
nod_jj_job2.text: Buzz roof, Apartments roof, Grand Hotel roof. Someone left cameras up there. Do not ask me how I know.

nod_jj_menace.speaker: J. J. Jameson
nod_jj_menace.text: Everybody in a mask is a menace until proven otherwise. That is journalism. Photos, kid!

nod_miles_freed.speaker: Miles
nod_miles_freed.text: You are the coolest person alive. Can you teach me the wall thing? No? Later? OK later.

nod_miles_tied.speaker: Miles
nod_miles_tied.text: You came! They tied me up here because I saw them carry crates into the warehouse. There is a big guy inside. Get me out of these ropes!

nod_miles_untie2.speaker: Miles
nod_miles_untie2.text: Thanks! I am going straight home. Well. Straight to the park. Then home.

qst_power.name: With Great Power
qst_power.description: First day in the mask. Talk to Aunt Mae on the stoop, get onto your own rooftop (walk into the wall, or press X at it), then deal with the thug in the alley.

steps.text: Talk to Aunt Mae by the front door
Get onto your rooftop (walk into the wall or press X at it)
Web and defeat the thug in the alley (X, then Space)

qst_purse.name: Purse Snatcher
qst_purse.description: A thug ran off with Rosa's purse into the alley behind the flower market. Take it back.

steps.text: Defeat the purse snatcher in the market alley

qst_bank.name: Bank Job
qst_bank.description: Three thugs are robbing the City Bank, south of Main across Park Avenue. Stop them.

qst_pizza.name: Pizza Time
qst_pizza.description: Papa Ray's order goes to Mr. Delmar on the Grand Hotel roof (north-east) in sixty seconds. Use the rooftops.

steps.text: Deliver to Mr. Delmar on the Grand Hotel roof

onFail.text: Cold pizza. Ray is not paying for that.

qst_photos.name: Front Page
qst_photos.description: The Daily Buzz wants three photos of the masked menace. The cameras are on the Buzz, Apartments and Grand Hotel roofs.

steps.text: Collect three photos from the rooftops
Bring them to J. J. Jameson at the Daily Buzz

qst_rescue.name: Rooftop Rescue
qst_rescue.description: Miles is tied up on the warehouse roof (south-east) with two guards. Get up there and free him.

steps.text: Free Miles on the warehouse roof

qst_showdown.name: Warehouse Showdown
qst_showdown.description: The Enforcer runs the thugs from the warehouse. Earn 3 reputation to get the door open, then take him down inside.

steps.text: Defeat the Enforcer in the warehouse

rewards.text: Warehouse Showdown: +$100  +200 XP. Downtown sleeps easier tonight.
